name: Metabolic Liver Disease and Hepatic Tumours

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Iron catalyses oxidative fibrosis while copper poisons basal ganglia mitochondria; HBV integrates oncogenically as cirrhotic nodules dysplasias into arterialised HCC, and chronic biliary inflammation metaplases ducts into desmoplastic adenocarcinoma.
additionalDifferentials: Alcoholic versus NASH by AST ALT and hyaline
PBC versus PSC by sex, antibodies and beading
HCC versus cholangio by washout and CA19-9
additionalInvestigations: Ferritin with transferrin saturation and HFE
Ceruloplasmin with urinary copper and slit lamp
Triple phase CT or MRI with AFP in cirrhosis
